description: This file contains URL parsing, normalization, and matching functions, along with relevant macros and helper methods for URL validation and comparison within a project related to git URL handling.

methods.name: int append_normalized_escapes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * from,size_t from_len,const char * esc_extra,const char * esc_ok)
methods.description: Append characters from 'from' to 'buf', unescaping safe characters and escaping unsafe ones per RFC 3986, normalizing %-escapes to uppercase, and handling extra escape characters.

methods.name: const char * end_of_token(const char * s,int c,size_t n)
methods.description: Find the position of the next occurrence of a character 'c' in string 's' within length 'n'.

methods.name: int match_host(const struct url_info * url_info,const struct url_info * pattern_info)
methods.description: Compare the host parts of two url_info structures, supporting wildcards and IPv6 literals.

methods.name: char * url_normalize_1(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info,char allow_globs)
methods.description: Normalize a full URL string: case normalization, unescaping and escaping characters, removing default ports, resolving dot segments, and handling IPv6 literals. Fills out url_info structure with parsing details.

methods.name: char * url_normalize(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info)
methods.description: Wrapper for url_normalize_1 with globs disabled, providing normalized URL string.

methods.name: size_t url_match_prefix(const char * url,const char * url_prefix,size_t url_prefix_len)
methods.description: Check if 'url_prefix' matches the start of 'url', respecting path boundaries.

methods.name: int match_urls(const struct url_info * url,const struct url_info * url_prefix,struct urlmatch_item * match)
methods.description: Determine if a URL matches a URL prefix based on scheme, host, port, and path components, and fill match details.

methods.name: int cmp_matches(const struct urlmatch_item * a,const struct urlmatch_item * b)
methods.description: Compare two urlmatch_item structures for ordering based on match quality.

methods.name: int urlmatch_config_entry(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Process a configuration entry related to URL match rules, involving normalization and comparison.

methods.name: void urlmatch_config_release(struct urlmatch_config * config)
methods.description: Release resources associated with a urlmatch_config structure.
